title: Shahrudi Language (SHM) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map, Endangered Level & Official Use | Ethnologue Free
text: Shahrudi is an endangered indigenous language of Iran. It belongs to the Indo-European language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by adults only. It is not known to be taught in schools.
